async def act(page):
    # Click on the first 'Show Reviews' link in the table to navigate to the product reviews page
    # Use the accessibility tree: table -> rowgroup -> row -> cell -> link
    first_show_reviews_link = page.get_by_role("table").get_by_role("rowgroup").nth(1).get_by_role("row").first.get_by_role("cell").get_by_role("link", name="Show Reviews")
    await first_show_reviews_link.click()
    # Wait for the page to load after navigation
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    return
